description_en: Deletes a G group. G groups are supported only in Number Pools designated for the AXG privacy number type
description_zh: 删除G号码组。仅AXG隐私号类型的号码池支持设置G号码组
name: DeleteAxgGroup

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the key of the number pool on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The G group ID (GID).

Log on to the Phone Number Privacy Protection console. On the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page, filter for number pools of the AXG Privacy Number type and click G Number Group Management to view the IDs of all G groups.

If you created the G group by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110250.html API, use the returned GroupID as the value for this GroupId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
AXG中的G组ID，即GID。

登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面筛选出AXG隐私号，单击G号码组管理即可查看所有G号码组的GID。
如果G号码组是通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110250.html创建的，则接口的返回参数**GroupID**就是此处的请求参数**GroupID**
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.

A value of OK indicates that the request was successful.

For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, generated by Alibaba Cloud
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符
